title: Eddy Current
definition: Eddy currents (also called Foucault currents) are loops of electrical current induced within conductors by a changing magnetic field in the conductor, according to Michael Faraday's law of induction.
importanceInUpsc: Essential microtopic for UPSC Civil Services GS Paper III (Science and Technology - Applications of Physics, Electromagnetism, Industrial Applications, Energy Conservation, and Magnetic Braking Systems).
learningOutcomes: Master foundational concepts and mechanisms of Eddy Current generation and suppression.
Evaluate spatial distribution, industrial applications, and mitigation engineering.
Apply high-yield mnemonics to solve tricky Prelims and Mains questions.
